_comment: Issue #1860 — the ONLY table in `public` permitted to run without RLS. It is owned by the PostGIS extension, not by us, and holds published coordinate-system reference data. Nine other names sat here from the #426 audit; every one of them was a real hole, and all nine now have RLS enabled by migration 20270321001860. Adding a name here fails .github/scripts/strict-grep/issue-1860-public-tables-rls-enabled.mjs (C2) unless its EXEMPT constant is changed in the same reviewed diff. That friction is the point.
